svg.title: jitllm architecture
svg.desc: Integrations (CLI, OpenAI-compatible server, LangChain4j and Quarkus, Java applications) on top of the public API and the serving engine; GGUF loading into model families registered as providers; the backend-neutral inference program; the TornadoVM backend that lowers each program once into task graphs, compiles them and replays them per token, with its kernels, native libraries and multi-GPU pipeline; TornadoVM compiling to CUDA, OpenCL and Metal; and the hardware. A CPU backend runs the same programs in plain Java.
svg.text: one ServiceLoader provider each, no central switch: Llama, Mistral, Devstral,
Gemma 4, GLM-4.7-Flash; immutable weights and configuration, shared by sessions
one forward pass as data: embedding, RMSNorm, RoPE, matmul, attention, KV append, SwiGLU, MoE routing, sampling ...
PREFILL and DECODE phases · runtime: DataType, KV leases, memory plan, execution policy, metrics
TornadoVM backend (backend/tornado): batched prefill, single-token decode; values move through control arrays, buffers are never rebound
hidden state over NCCL or the host
JIT-compiles the Java kernels for the device: CUDA C (NVRTC), OpenCL C, Metal Shading Language
